paleography.indonesian_translation: Om awighnam astu namas siddham. Inilah tata cara pengobatan anak (usadha rare), hendaknya dipahami oleh mereka yang mengabdi pada kebenaran dan hakikat budi pekerti. Adapun jika anak baru lahir, jangan lengah mengamati tanda-tanda pada tubuh bayi, serta tangan dan kakinya, begitu pula pandangan matanya. Jika bagian putih matanya tampak kebiruan, tangan dan kakinya dingin, tangisnya parau/tercekat, serta tampak sayu/mengantuk dan tubuhnya dingin demikian, sakitnya disebut blahan namanya. Obatnya, sarana: sembung, beras merah, gamongan, ditempelkan pada ubun-ubunnya (blahan). Dan untuk bedak/balur tangan dan kakinya, sarana: buah sirih, nekuning, wangkongsari, jabug garum, pes gadu bang, dibalurkan/dijadikan bedak, jangan sampai bayi tersebut dimandikan secara berlebihan. Dan untuk bagian dadanya/depannya, sarana: umbi tunjung, bawang dadas. Dan jika bagian putih matanya biru, urat-uratnya terlihat merah seperti darah, dan wajahnya pucat/lesu serta mengantuk...
paleography.english_translation: Om awighnam astu namas siddham. This is the procedure of child medicine (usadha rare), to be understood by those serving virtue and wisdom. If a child is born, do not be careless in examining the signs of the infant, including its hands and feet, and the center of its eyes. If the white of its eyes looks blue, its hands and feet are cold, its crying is choked/hoarse, and it appears drowsy/droopy and cold like that, its illness is named blahan. Its remedy, ingredients: sembung, red rice, gamongan, applied onto its fontanel (blahan). And for the powder/balm for its hands and feet, ingredients: betel nut/fruit (buah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabug garum, pes gadu bang, applied as a powder/rub; do not bathe the child excessively. And for its chest/front, ingredients: water lily tuber (humbi tuntung), crushed shallot (bawang dadas). And if the white of its eyes is blue, its veins appear blood-red, and its appearance is limp/pale, and drowsy...

paleography.indonesian_translation: Semoga tiada rintangan dan berhasil. Inilah tata cara pengobatan anak-anak (usadha rare), patut diketahui oleh mereka yang mengabdi pada kebenaran dan hakikat budi pekerti. Adapun bila bayi telah lahir, janganlah lalai mengenali tanda-tanda atau keadaan sang bayi, serta tangan dan kakinya, juga sorot matanya. Bila putih matanya tampak biru, tangannya dan kakinya dingin, tangisnya tersendat-sendat (serak), serta matanya terpejam sayu, jika dingin keadaannya demikian, penyakitnya disebut 'blahan'. Obatnya, sarananya: sembung, beras merah, gamongan, ditempelkan pada ubun-ubunnya (blahan). Dan untuk bedak/balur tangan dan kakinya, sarananya: buah pinang/sirih (bwah base), nekuning, wangkongsari, jabuggarum, pesgadubhang, dibalurkan/dibedaki, jangan sering memandikan bayi tersebut. paleography.english_translation: May there be no obstacles and may success prevail. This is the procedure for infant medicine (usadha rare), to be understood by those who observe the duty of true wisdom. When an infant is born, do not be negligent in observing the signs and vitality of the infant, as well as its hands, feet, and eyes. If the whites of its eyes appear bluish, its hands and feet are cold, its cry is choked/raspy, and its eyes are heavy/closing, cold like that, its illness is named 'blahan'. Its remedy, ingredients: sembung, red rice, gamongan, applied (tampel) on the fontanelle (blahan). And for the powder/rub for its hands and feet, ingredients: bwah base, nekuning, wangkongsari, jabuggarum, pesgadubhang, applied as a rub; do not bathe the child too often. And for the front of its chest, ingredients: umbi tunjung (water lily tuber), roasted/crushed shallot (bawang dadas). And if the whites of its eyes are blue, its veins visible like blood, and its complexion pale/limp, and closing its eyes...

paleography.indonesian_translation: 1. Inilah tanda-tanda (karakteristik) kucing, baik-buruk rupa serta perilakunya. Jika ada kucing dengan warna bulu seragam, memiliki tanda belang/cundang di sela alisnya, atau sejenis tanda cundang, memiliki pusaran bulu di ketiak kiri dan kanan, serta satu di dagu, itu pertanda baik. Khasiat/pahalanya: tidak akan didatangi oleh orang jahat, orang berniat jahat akan gagal karenanya; jika ada yang mengirim santet/teluh, sihir perusak, semuanya akan lebur/binasa karenanya, demikian keutamaannya. Kucing berbulu hitam, keempat kakinya bergaris/berbelang (panjal), ekornya bundel (bergelung/tumpul), itu bertanda baik (sulaksana), pahalanya membawa kemakmuran, kekuasaan, dan tidak kekurangan harta. Kucing yang seluruh badannya hitam, lambung kirinya memiliki bercak putih, terlebih lagi jika ekornya bundel, dinamakan 'Wulan Karahinan', bertanda baik, segala yang diupayakan berhasil. Kucing yang seluruh badannya putih, lambung kanannya memiliki bercak hitam, terlebih lagi jika ekornya bundel, dinamakan 'Wulan Purnama', bertanda baik, pahalanya mendapatkan kebahagiaan yang berkesinambungan. Kucing berbadan putih, kepalanya hitam, ekornya bundel, itu bertanda baik, dinamakan 'Bhujangga Hamengku', pahalanya sangat utama.
paleography.english_translation: 1. These are the characteristics of cats, the good and bad of their appearance and behavior. If there is a cat of uniform fur color, with marks between its eyebrows, any kind of mark, with hair whorls on both left and right armpits/flanks, and one on the chin; its outcome: it will not be approached by malicious people, evil intentions of humans will be thwarted by it, if there is witchcraft/black magic or disturbing spirits, they are destroyed by it; such is its excellence. A cat with black fur, all four legs striped/banded (panjal), its tail kinky/bobbed; it has good characteristics (sulaksana), its outcome is joy, power, and never lacking wealth. A cat whose entire body is black, with a white patch on its left flank, especially if its tail is bobbed; it is named 'Wulan Karahinan', possessing good characteristics, whatever is intended succeeds. A cat whose entire body is white, with a black patch on its right flank, especially if its tail is bobbed; it is named 'Wulan Purnama', possessing good characteristics, its outcome brings continuous good fortune. A cat whose body is white, its head black, its tail bobbed; it has good characteristics, named 'Bhujangga Hamengku', its outcome brings great virtue/fortune.

paleography.indonesian_translation: 1, // Inilah tanda-tanda (ciri-ciri) kucing, baik dan buruk rupa serta tingkah lakunya. Jika ada kucing berbulu mulus sewarna, ada belang di antara alisnya, segala jenis belang, berpusar di ketiak kiri dan kanan, serta satu di dagu, khasiatnya: tidak akan didatangi oleh orang jahat, niat orang jahat akan digagalkan olehnya; jika ada teluh, ada gangguan gaib, dinetralkan olehnya; demikian keutamaannya. || 0 || Kucing berbulu hitam, keempat kakinya berbelang (berkaus kaki), ekornya bundel (bergelung), tandanya: memiliki tanda baik (sulaksana), hasilnya berupa kekuasaan dan kebahagiaan, tidak kekurangan harta kekayaan. || 0 || Kucing yang seluruh tubuhnya hitam, lambung kirinya memiliki bercak putih, lebih-lebih jika ekornya bundel, tandanya bernama Wulan Karahinan, bertanda baik, apa pun yang dikehendaki akan terkabul. || 0 || Kucing yang seluruh tubuhnya putih, lambung kanannya memiliki bercak hitam, lebih-lebih jika ekornya bundel, dinamai Wulan Purnama, bertanda baik, hasilnya: senantiasa didatangi kebahagiaan seumur hidup. || 0 || Kucing yang tubuhnya putih, kepalanya hitam, ekornya bundel, tandanya: bertanda baik, bernama Bhujangga Hamengku, hasilnya sangat besar keutamaannya. || 0 ||
paleography.english_translation: 1, // Here are the characteristics of cats, the good and bad of their appearance and their behaviour. If there is a cat of uniform coat color, marked between its eyebrows, any form of blaze, with hair whorls on both the left and right armpits and one on the chin, its virtue: it will not be approached by evil people, the malicious intent of bad people will be foiled by it; if there is black magic (desti) or malevolent spirits causing trouble, it will be neutralized by it; such is its excellence. || 0 || A cat with black fur, all four legs marked (socks), with a bundled/kinked tail, its mark: good omen (sulaksana), the result is joy and power/influence, never lacking in wealth. || 0 || A cat whose entire body is black, with a white patch on its left flank, even more so if its tail is bundled/kinked, marked with the name Wulan Karahinan, a good omen, whatever is intended will be achieved. || 0 || A cat whose entire body is white, with a black patch on its right flank, even more so if its tail is bundled/kinked, named Wulan Purnama, a good omen, the result: continuous good fortune will arrive. || 0 || A cat with a white body, a black head, and a bundled/kinked tail, its mark: a good omen, named Bhujangga Hamengku, its result is of great excellence. || 0 ||

paleography.indonesian_translation: Tidak ada yang tiba-tiba berkehendak mencari kemasyhuran... // Semoga tiada rintangan // Sang pahlawan yang mempersembahkan kurban suci di medan perang berkehendak melenyapkan para musuh, bagaikan bunga yang bertaburan helai rambut musuh di arena pertempuran, darah para raja yang gugur menjadi biji-bijian kurban dan perapiannya adalah negeri musuh yang terbakar... demikianlah para kesatria agung di medan laga mempersembahkan kurban perang...
paleography.english_translation: There is none who suddenly seeks fame... // May there be no obstacle // The hero who performs sacrifice on the battlefield desires the destruction of the enemies, casually scattering like flowers the hairs of the foes upon the battleground; the blood of slain kings becomes the sacrificial grain and their sacrificial hearth is the blazing territory of the enemies; thus the great heroes on the battlefield offer up sacrifice in warfare...

paleography.indonesian_translation: Tidak ada yang tiba-tiba berhasrat untuk termasyhur... permata yang cemerlang... tak henti-hentinya... Semoga tiada rintangan. Sang pemberani yang melaksanakan kurban di medan perang berniat melenyapkan para musuh, bagaikan bunga yang bertaburan, rambut musuh di medan pertempuran, darah para raja yang gugur menjadi biji-bijian persembahannya, perapian kurbannya adalah negeri musuh...
paleography.english_translation: There is no one who suddenly strives for fame... radiant jewel... unendingly... May there be no obstacles. The heroes who perform sacrifice on the battlefield intend to destroy the enemies, leisurely like scattered flowers, the hair of enemies on the battlefield, the blood of fallen kings is their sacrificial grain, the sacrificial hearth is the enemy's city...
